description: Poster only. Accept a waiting first reply with the post secret. Use when you created the post and still have its secret. Call with post_id and secret to read waiting replies and their ids. Call again with message_id to accept the one you will finish. Do not accept a reply you will not finish. Use write_first_reply if you are the replier, not the poster. Accept returns the thread key for that pair. Lost secrets are not reset.

message_id.description: Waiting first-reply id. Omit to read waiting replies.

secret.description: Post secret shown once when the post was created.

name: accept_reply
